verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly advertises fitting into existing Git/GitHub Actions/VS Code/framework workflows with 'no proprietary tools or vendor lock-in' (cloudflare-docs-7), and Wrangler/workers-sdk integrate with standard CI and editors. However, community feedback directly contradicts the no-lock-in claim, citing proprietary storage APIs (KV, D1) that make switching away hard, and lack of a full Node runtime blocking migration of standard framework apps from Vercel/Netlify.
